svg.text: of Spark's sin, cos, tan, tanh and cbrt
each tier gives the same bits for all
one answer per column in all three
the same count on both, of 262,144 inputs:
tanh and cbrt change: 130,493 and 86,791 of 1,048,576 inputs
Arm replaces only sin and cos (19,081, 17,697 of 262,144
differ from fdlibm); x86 all five
laptop against Arm, of 1,048,576 inputs: sin 66,122, cos 43,725, tan 22,721, tanh 130,493, cbrt 86,791
not the CPU model, not the tier, not the code path:
the instruction set and the JDK build decide which routine computes Math.sin
